glossary.json/compact-dict: {"definition": "CPython’s dictionary layout since 3.6: sparse indices point into insertion-ordered entries. Ordinary combined tables with general keys store hash, key and value per entry; Unicode-only and shared-key tables use different entry layouts."}

glossary.json/dict-entries: {"definition": "The insertion-ordered entries area in CPython’s compact dictionary. General-key combined entries contain hash, key and value; Unicode-only and shared-key layouts differ. Deleted entries may leave holes until compaction."}

glossary.json/perturbed-probing: {"definition": "CPython’s dictionary probe sequence uses a signed hash interpreted as an unsigned word. It shifts that perturb value right by five bits before using it in the next-slot calculation, feeding high hash bits into early probes; after perturb reaches zero, the recurrence visits every slot."}
glossary.json/cardinality: {"example": "The set of distinct values in [a, b, a] has cardinality 2; the list itself has three positions."}

glossary.json/dsa-ip: {"definition": "The Internet Protocol: packet addressing and delivery across interconnected networks. IP addresses identify network interfaces or endpoints; a device can have multiple addresses."}

hash-collision-chaining: Every entry is a separate heap node with a `next` pointer, and following pointers means cache misses: often the dominant cost on modern CPUs. → In a node-based linked-list implementation, each entry has a `next` pointer and may live in a separate allocation. Following those pointers can incur cache misses; their importance depends on representation and workload.

hash-collision-linear-probes: The catch: the load factor must stay below 1 (there can never be more keys than slots), and performance falls off sharply as it approaches 1. → The load factor cannot exceed one: there are no more key positions than slots. A completely full table can still search with a bounded complete probe cycle, but has no room for a new key. Designs that stop misses only at an empty slot keep spare slots, and performance falls off sharply as fullness approaches one.
